label: SECONDARY POST-BENCHMARK DIAGNOSTIC / IMPROVED INFERENCE VARIANT -- not the official benchmark, does not replace it
preregistered_before_seeing: any padded-crop inference or scoring result; only architecture probing (vgsl_timestep_probe.py) and geometry/GT-length facts already published in GAP_ANALYSIS.md and ctc_timestep_summary.json were used to set MIN_WIDTH
hypothesis: Ensuring a minimum horizontal input width (hence a minimum CTC timestep budget) reduces Loghi's empty-output and under-production failure modes on short/narrow line crops, specifically because narrow crops leave the model little timestep margin above the bare CTC minimum, and a weakly-trained (scratch) model is disproportionately likely to collapse to a degenerate/empty output when that margin is tight -- not because the correct answer is architecturally unrepresentable (only 2/71 official empty lines are strictly T < T_min).

architecture_derivation.source: confirmed identical between training/scratch_epoch_runner.py's RECOMMENDED_VGSL_SPEC and the live pinned container's get_model_library()['recommended']
architecture_derivation.instrumentation_method: built the real 'recommended' model inside the pinned container (loghi/docker.htr:latest@sha256:414fc89ac574a61fd745836ad9852842759bf3cf7046e4549ae96315ff9132e8) via VGSLModelGenerator and ran 25 real forward passes on synthetic zero tensors at widths 8..900; confirmed input axis order empirically as (batch, width[None], height[64], channels[1])
architecture_derivation.empirical_result: T_timesteps = ceil(resized_width / 8), exact fit across all 25 probed widths (three Mp2,2,2,2 stride-2 maxpool stages give an exact 8x horizontal downsampling; Cr* conv layers use 'same' padding; Bl512 LSTM layers do not change the time axis)
architecture_derivation.resize_rule: the model resizes every crop to fixed height 64 with the width scaled proportionally: resized_width = original_crop_width * 64 / original_crop_height
architecture_derivation.ctc_minimum_alignment: T_min = L + R, where L = reference character length and R = count of immediately-adjacent repeated-character pairs in the reference (a blank must separate two adjacent identical labels or CTC repeat-collapse merges them)

empirical_sufficiency_check_on_official_.honest_caveat: the strict CTC-impossibility mechanism explains only 2/71 empty outputs; the remaining association is a margin/confidence effect (empty lines have far less slack on average), not an architectural impossibility. The padding experiment tests this softer, partially-supported mechanism, not a hard sufficiency claim.

min_width_derivation.rule: derived entirely from geometry (image_width/image_height, a preprocessing/dataset property) and reference-length facts (GT transcription length, a dataset/problem-specification property). Never used loghi_status, loghi_empty, or loghi_cer -- i.e. never chosen by trying candidate widths against benchmark performance.

inputs.reference_note: p95 used instead of the single max (33, one line) to avoid one outlier dictating the global constant
inputs.healthy_population_definition: lines with official image_width >= 200px (n=4288, clearly not width-starved)
inputs.reference_note_2: p25 (lower quartile, a conservative reference) of the healthy population's own T-minus-T_min slack, used as the 'comfortable margin' target rather than its median or mean
inputs.reference_note_3: p99 of narrow-line heights, so the derivation is conservative even for the tallest narrow crops (taller crop => smaller resized_width => smaller T for a fixed padded original width)

min_width_derivation.formula: needed_T = narrow_T_min_p95 + healthy_slack_p25 = 7 + 12 = 19; resized_width_needed = needed_T * 8 = 152; MIN_WIDTH = ceil(resized_width_needed * worst_case_height / 64) = ceil(152 * 95 / 64) = 226px
min_width_derivation.rounding: rounded up to 230px as a clean, slightly more conservative constant
min_width_derivation.applies_to: the original (pre-Loghi-resize) crop width, before the container's internal resize-to-height-64 step
min_width_derivation.uncertainty_statement: the exact width->timestep transformation (T=ceil(resized_width/8)) and the CTC minimum (T_min=L+R) are exactly derived from code/theory, not guessed. The MARGIN target (19 timesteps of slack) is a judgment call, explicitly using conservative (p95/p25/p99) rather than central statistics, and is stated here as such rather than hidden.

padding_rule.name: symmetric background padding, no rescaling
padding_rule.condition: apply only if official image_width < MIN_WIDTH_px (230)
padding_rule.action: pad_total = MIN_WIDTH_px - original_width; pad_left = pad_total // 2; pad_right = pad_total - pad_left (any odd leftover pixel goes right); handwriting pixels are copied unchanged and centered, never stretched, rescaled, rotated, contrast-enhanced, or denoised; height is never changed
padding_rule.fill_value_rule: per-line, data-derived from the crop's own image content only (never GT-dependent): the mean RGB colour of a 2px-wide strip at that line's own left edge and right edge (whichever side is being padded uses that side's own edge-strip mean; if a side needs padding but has no source pixels on that side because pad covers the full former edge region, it uses the same crop's opposite-edge strip as fallback -- in practice every crop has both edges available since padding only adds pixels, never removes them)
padding_rule.unaffected_lines: lines with official image_width >= 230px are copied byte-identical (same PNG bytes, same hash) into the derived crop set; no exceptions expected or observed
padding_rule.png_encoding: identical to the official crop policy: PIL PNG save with optimize=False, compress_level=6 (imaging.PNG_SAVE_KWARGS), same RGB mode
padding_rule.gt_and_ids_unchanged: line_id, page_id, document_id, gt_canonical, gt_canonical_sha256, and eligibility are copied unmodified from the official manifest; only line_image_path (to the derived crop) and image_width/image_sha256 (for padded lines) are recomputed

run_scope.model_run: Loghi only, same checkpoint/profile/beam width 10/Docker image digest/tokenizer/runtime as the official primary run
run_scope.lion_rerun: none -- official Lion predictions are used as the fixed reference throughout
run_scope.overwrite_policy: never overwrites benchmark-data/reports/svea-hovratt-v2-primary-20260927T102311Z/ or any file in ../ (the Phase C gap-analysis directory); all new outputs live under this loghi-minwidth-padding-v1/ subdirectory
